name: How can I tell if a drywall finishing job is high quality?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if a drywall finishing job is high quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: A high-quality drywall finishing job exhibits several key characteristics. The surface should appear smooth and uniform, free from visible seams, nail pops, or uneven patches, especially under normal lighting conditions. There should be no sanding marks, ridges, or depressions. Edges and corners should be straight and sharp. If a texture was applied, it should be consistent across the entire surface without blotches or thin spots. Ultimately, a quality finish creates a seamless, paint-ready canvas that looks clean and professional, allowing paint to adhere perfectly without highlighting flaws.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-quality drywall finishing results in a smooth, uniform surface free of visible seams, nail pops, sanding marks, or unevenness, with straight edges and consistent texture if applied, providing a flawless base for paint.
